::: {#def-rnffrcitg .theorem}
## RNFFRCISTG model

A random network finest fully randomized causally interpretable structured tree graph (RNFFRCISTG) is a causal model of an [NPSEM-GE](#def-npsem-ne) that satisfies (1) [no within-covariate influence](#def-no-spillover), (2) [homogeneous random network interference](#def-homogenous-random-network-interference) with respect to graph generators $\mathcal H$, (3) [identical distributions](#def-identical-distributions), and (4) [single-world independence](#def-single-world) over the structural variables, which are also assumed jointly independent of the generators' error terms.

Clause (4) is the [FFRCISTG](#def-ffrcistg) condition restricted to the structural variables, which is what identification requires. It does not extend to the relational variables, whose error terms are dependent within a generator by construction.

Because the network is generated inside the model rather than supplied to it, uncertainty about the network is representable, and regimes that act on the network can be considered alongside regimes that act on treatment. Without further structure, however, little is learnable from a single realization of one graph.
:::
